reason: The free first visit means I can check the cleanliness claims and the never-packed promise at no cost, and if it is really nicer than CoCo's I would pay for a visit or two and tell my moms group. I would not commit to a pack or a membership until I have seen it myself.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? At $13 a kid and more for siblings it adds up fast on my budget, and I need to see that the clean and not-crowded part is real.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend or after-work price closer to $10 a child, or the moms-group rate also applying outside weekday mornings, since I work during the day.
